description: February 25 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 25 birthday falls in Pisces, in the first decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: February 25 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Few birthdays lean as inward as February 25. The 25 reduces to 7, numerology's mystic and analyst, and the Sun is around six degrees into Pisces, where Neptune rules sign and decan alike. Together they suggest someone drawn to spiritual questions, symbolism and solitude, who often notices meanings that busier people walk straight past.

On February 25 the Sun usually sits at about 6° Pisces, in the first decan, where Neptune rules the decan as well as the sign. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, also governs the sign's first decan, from about February 19 to February 28. This is often seen as the most dreamy and boundless part of the zodiac's final sign. Natives tend to be imaginative, compassionate and highly sensitive to music, mood and meaning. They may move through the world like a sponge, absorbing atmosphere and other people's feelings. Doubled Neptune can blur practical edges and make escape tempting when life feels harsh. Creative work, spiritual practice and caring roles often give this decan a way to channel what it senses.

sections.heading: February 25 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 25 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 25: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 25 is the 56th day of the year. By March 21, 25 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aries.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by February 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on February 25 include George Harrison (1943), Pierre-Auguste Renoir (1841) and Carlo Goldoni (1707).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 25?
faq.answer: February 25 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 25 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 25?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a February 25 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 25?
faq.answer: February 25 is also the birthday of George Harrison (1943), Pierre-Auguste Renoir (1841) and Carlo Goldoni (1707). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
